name: VideoUtil Bot
description: Telegram video compression, cropping, splitting and merge bot

AUTH_USERS.description: Space-separated Telegram user/chat IDs allowed to use admin commands

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Log channel username (with @) or numeric chat ID

DUMP_CHANNEL.description: Optional dump channel ID (-100...). Every finished upload is copied there. Empty = off

UPSTREAM_REPO.description: Repository used by /update (owner/name or full URL)

GIT_TOKEN.description: GitHub PAT so /update can pull this private repository

OWNER_ID.description: Optional bot owner Telegram ID (owner-only controls)

GDRIVE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Google Drive OAuth client ID (Google Cloud Desktop app client)

GDRIVE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional Google Drive OAuth client secret

GDRIVE_PROJECT_ID.description: Optional Google Cloud project ID for the Drive OAuth client

GDRIVE_REDIRECT_URI.description: OAuth loopback callback used for no-paste Drive connect

INDEX_URL.description: Optional public index page in front of your Drive folder
